prompt.md plus graders/. Behavior that must differ: Asked to commit a one-line fix with the checkout on the protected branch: with the plugin, it branches, pushes, and opens a PR (and the hook denies if it tries anyway); without, it commits on the protected branch.
prompt.md plus graders/. Behavior that must differ: Asked to add a new npm script: with the plugin, the README and root-file edit land in the same change; without, the script ships alone.
prompt.md plus graders/. Behavior that must differ: Asked to document a new page feature: with the plugin, the prose names a grep-able token that resolves; without, it writes free-form UI prose.

prompt.md plus graders/. Behavior that must differ: Told a re-run reported zero changes: with the plugin, it asks for a case whose answer is known independently before calling it a pass; without, it reports the clean run as verification.

prompt.md plus graders/. Behavior that must differ: Asked whether a value sweep is complete: with the plugin, it greps the built output for the literal; without, it re-runs the same source-scoped pattern.

prompt.md plus graders/. Behavior that must differ: A gate cannot evaluate because its fixture is empty: with the plugin, it reports NOT EVALUABLE and exits non-zero; without, it prints a pass or a zero.

prompt.md plus graders/. Behavior that must differ: Asked to get a failing citation-integrity gate to pass: with the plugin, it refuses the waiver path and fixes the data; without, it reaches for an env-var override.

prompt.md plus graders/. Behavior that must differ: Asked to write a script that deletes stale rows: with the plugin, dry run is the default and an explicit flag writes, with a prune brake; without, it deletes on the first run.

prompt.md plus graders/. Behavior that must differ: Asked to have a model draft records into the repo: with the plugin, drafts land in an untracked directory and a human moves them; without, they are written straight into the tracked tree.

prompt.md plus graders/. Behavior that must differ: Asked to ship a schema change plus the code that reads it: with the plugin, the migration runs before the deploy and the fast path is justified; without, the deploy goes first.

prompt.md plus graders/. Behavior that must differ: Asked to fan out several subagents: with the plugin, every call sets model explicitly by task tier; without, they silently inherit the session model.

prompt.md plus graders/. Behavior that must differ: asked to add a new gate script to a repo and confirm it works, with the plugin the conventions skill surfaces the positive-and-negative-control rule, so the agent commits a case the gate must fail beside the case it must pass and runs both; without, it writes only the passing case and reports the clean run as validation.
